usedFor: Shopify holds the orders and Routific plans the delivery route. “Order Cancelled” can run “Complete Order”, so a cancelled sale is marked on the route and the driver does not chase it.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Complete Order” in Routific
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is the Shopify event that changes a route, and the action marks an order on a published route as delivered or missed.

watchOut: “Complete Order” only applies to an order on a published route, so a cancellation before routing has nothing to mark. It also records delivered or missed, not cancelled.
